newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-SMITH KICKS 23 POINTS AS FREE STATE UPSET NATAL.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SMITH KICKS 23 POINTS AS FREE STATE UPSET NATAL.

text.p: Replacement fly half M.J. Smith kicked 23 points as his Free State team upset Natal 45-40 in their Super 12 match on Saturday.
The Cheetahs, who beat Queensland 35-24 in their last Super 12 outing, ran in three first-half tries in a game played at tremendous pace throughout in the Free State Stadium.
Opening up the Natal defence with their speed on the counter-attack, the home side led 42-26 with eight minutes remaining.
And although Natal finished strongly with two converted tries in the closing stages, the final scoreline flattered the previously unbeaten Sharks.
However, Natal's five tries and defeat by less than seven points did earn them two bonus points.
First choice fly-half Jannie de Beer had to leave the field in the 24th minute after being winded by a Joos Joubert tackle but Smith came on to produce a 100 percent accurate display of kicking.
Smith landed seven penalties, including one from 52 metres, and a conversion for his 23-point haul.
Natal, unbeaten in their opening two matches of the season, were rocked by two Free State tries in the first 12 minutes on Saturday.
Down 27-11 at the break, Natal came back strongly in the second half with tries from John Allan, Ollie Le Roux and captain Gary Teichmann.
But Free State always had enough in reserve and can now depart on Sunday for their tour of Australia and New Zealand with increased confidence.

Natal: Gavin Lawless; Dirkie Strydom, Jeremy Thomson, Joos Joubert, Cabous van der Westhuizen; Henry Honiball, Robert du Preez (Kevin Putt, 61); Gary Teichmann (captain), Wayne Fyvie, Dieter Kriese (Wickus van Heerden, 53), Mark Andrews, John Slade, Adrian Garvey, John Allan, Rob Kempson (Ollie le Roux, 53).

Free State: Jorrie Kruger; Chris Badenhorst, Helgard Muller (captain), Brendan Venter, Jan-Harm van Wyk; Jannie de Beer (M.J. Smith, 24), Werner Swanepoel; Jaco Coetzee, Johan Erasmus, Charl van Rensburg, Braam Els, Stuart Landman, Dougie Heymans, Naka Drotske, Os du Randt.
